content: Official Win32 documentation confirms WS_EX_LAYERED supports per-pixel alpha, UpdateLayeredWindow supplies the full surface, transparent alpha pixels can pass hit testing, and WS_EX_TRANSPARENT passes mouse events through the entire overlay. Apple AppKit exposes NSWindow.ignoresMouseEvents for click-through and collectionBehavior.fullScreenAuxiliary/canJoinAllApplications for overlays in full-screen spaces. Recommend a native window adapter per OS with an explicit interactive/click-through state.
